readout_other: open field test; three-chamber social test; GCaMP6s fiber photometry; c-fos TetTag mCherry labelling
direction_notes: Photoacoustic stimulation activated mPFC neurons (mCherry labelling, calcium transients rising with 0.4, 0.6 and 0.8 MPa) and, applied after acute social defeat stress, increased open-field centre time and social engagement in the first three-chamber session versus sham.

device.model: Ti3C2Tx/PDMS fiber-optic photoacoustic emitter (FPE), 200 um, excited by Lapa-20 pulse laser

timing.protocol_description: Ultrasound is generated at the fibre tip by a 1064 nm pulse laser (10 ns pulse width, 0-10 mJ/pulse, 20 Hz repetition rate); the paper gives 0.4, 0.6 and 0.8 MPa photoacoustic levels, with 1 hour of stimulation at 0.8 MPa in the behavioural experiment.

source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: the peak-to-peak ultrasound intensity generated by the FPE is 0.7 MPa (positive peak 0.4 MPa, center frequency: 4 MHz)
source_quotes.exposures[0].unspecified_domain.pressure: photoacoustic stimulation of varying ultrasonic peak levels (0.4, 0.6, 0.8 MPa) induced calcium changes of differing intensities
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_repetition_fre: The parameters of the pulse laser are as follows: energy: 0–10 mJ/pulse, pulse width: 10 ns, wavelength: 1064 nm, pulse repetition rate: 20 Hz
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: After 1 hour of photoacoustic stimulation at 0.8 MPa

flags.reason: 4 MHz is the centre frequency of the bench-characterised FPE output at 10 mJ/cm2 (peak-to-peak 0.7 MPa); the frequency used in vivo is not restated.
Peak levels 0.4-0.8 MPa given for in vivo stimulation without saying whether water-measured, peak or peak-to-peak.
20 Hz is the laser pulse repetition rate listed in the fabrication section; stimulation PRF in vivo not otherwise stated.
Text says 1 hour of photoacoustic stimulation at 0.8 MPa; whether continuous trains for 1 h is not stated.
Photoacoustic broadband transient from a 10 ns laser pulse, not a sustained carrier; may fail inclusion condition B (ultrasound as a sustained waveform at a carrier frequency).
Only n = 4 mice for the photometry heatmap is stated; behaviour group size is not given.
mPFC mapped to ventromedial_prefrontal_cortex per the synonym list (medial prefrontal, mPFC).
Only the 10 ns laser pulse width is given, which is not the acoustic pulse duration.
